full_judgment: 2. Predecessor-in-interest of the petitioners filed the aforesaid Case under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act for pre-emption of the case land on the allegation that he is a co-sharer on the basis of a deed of gift and that the pre-emptee purchased the suit land on the basis of a registered deed Of sale dated 3-3-1983 executed in pursuance of a decree passed in Title Suit No.80 of 1978 and he came to know about the same after obtaining the certified copy on 22-11-1983. The case was contested by the pre-emptee denying the material allegations and stating that the case is not maintainable and barred by limitation estoppel waiver acquiescence and defect of parties. His case it that he is a co-sharer in the suit holding and as such the pre-emption case against him is not maintainable.
